RV-1.1.ar: min ajli fahmin ṣaḥīḥin li-l-lafẓi wa-l-maʿnā, anḥanī li-Bārfātī wa-Bārāmīshfārā, wālidayi al-ʿālam, al-muttaḥidayni ka-ttiḥādi al-lafẓi bi-maʿnāh.
RV-1.1.zh: wèile zhèngquè lǐjiě yányǔ yǔ yìyì, wǒ lǐjìng shìjiè de fùmǔ — Pà'ěrwǎdì yǔ Dà Zìzàitiān, tāmen xiānghù jiéhé, rútóng yányǔ yǔ qí yìyì.
RV-1.1.ja: kotoba to imi o tadashiku rikai suru tame ni, kotoba to sono imi no yō ni musubareta sekai no fubo, Pārvatī to Paramēshuvara ni raihai shimasu.

RV-1.2.ar: ayna as-sulālatu al-mawlūdatu mina sh-shams, wa-ayna ʿaqlī ḍayyiqu al-idrāk! min farṭi al-ḥamāqati urīdu an aʿbura muḥīṭan lā yuʿbaru ʿalā ṭawfin ṣaghīr.
RV-1.2.zh: yuánzì tàiyáng de wángzú hé qí wěidà, wǒ zhè jiànshi qiǎnbó de xīnzhì yòu hé qí miǎoxiǎo! wǒ jìng chūyú yúchī, xiǎng chéng yì zhī xiǎo fá dùguò nányǐ yúyuè de dàhǎi.
RV-1.2.ja: taiyō kara umareta ōtō wa nanto idai de, asahaka na watashi no chie wa nanto chiisai koto ka. oroka ni mo watashi wa chiisa na ikada de watarigatai taikai o watarō to shite iru.

RV-1.3.ar: wa-anā al-balīdu aṭ-ṭāmiʿu fī majdi sh-shuʿarāʾi sa-aṣīru uḍḥūka, ka-qizmin yarfaʿu dhirāʿayhi ṭamaʿan fī thamaratin lā yanāluhā illā aṭ-ṭawīl.
RV-1.3.zh: wǒ yúdùn què kěqiú shīrén de míngshēng, bì jiāng lúnwéi xiàobǐng, jiù xiàng zhūrú chūyú tānxīn, xiàng zhǐyǒu gāo gèzi cái gòu de zháo de guǒzi jǔqǐ shuāngbì.
RV-1.3.ja: gudon de ari nagara shijin no meisei o nozomu watashi wa, se no takai mono ni shika todokanai kajitsu o hoshigatte ude o nobasu kobito no yō ni, waraimono ni naru darō.

RV-1.4.ar: aw bi-l-aḥrā: lammā kāna sh-shuʿarāʾu as-sābiqūna qad fataḥū bāban mina l-kalimāti ilā hādhihi s-sulāla, fa-inna lī sabīlan ilayhā, kamā yamurru l-khayṭu fī jawharatin thaqabahā l-māsu min qabl.
RV-1.4.zh: huòzhě shuō, jìrán qiándài shīrén yǐ wèi zhè yī wángzú kāipì le yáncí zhī mén, wǒ biàn néng jìnrù qízhōng, zhèngrú sīxiàn néng chuānguò yǐ bèi jīngāngzuàn zuàntòu de bǎoshí.
RV-1.4.ja: iya, mushiro sendai no shijin-tachi ga kono ōtō ni kotoba no mon o sude ni hiraite iru node, daiyamondo de ana o aketa hōseki ni ito ga tōru yō ni, watashi mo haitte ikeru.

RV-1.5.ar: wa-anā, ʿalā mā anā ʿalayh, (sa-arwī nasaba āli Rāghū,) aṭ-ṭāhirīna mundhu l-wilāda, alladhīna atammū aʿmālahum ḥattā athmarat, wa-malakū l-arḍa ḥattā l-muḥīṭ, wa-balaghat ṭuruqu ʿarabātihim as-samāʾ;
RV-1.5.zh: wǒ suī rúcǐ, (réng jiāng jiǎngshù Luóhù zú de shìxì,) tāmen shēnglái qīngjìng, xíngshì zhízhì jiéguǒ, tǒngzhì dàdì zhízhì hǎibiān, chēzhé zhídá tiānjiè;
RV-1.5.ja: sono yō na watashi ga (Ragu-zoku no keifu o katarō) — karera wa umarenagara ni kiyoraka de, mi o musubu made tsutome o hatashi, umi ni itaru made daichi o osame, sono sensha no michi wa ten ni made oyonda.

RV-1.6.ar: alladhīna qarrabū l-qarābīna li-n-nīrāni l-muqaddasati kamā taqḍī sh-sharīʿa, wa-akramū s-sāʾilīna bi-qadri mā tamannaw, wa-ʿāqabū ʿalā qadri dh-dhanb, wa-staiqaẓū fī l-waqti l-munāsib;
RV-1.6.zh: tāmen yīzhào yíguǐ xiàng shènghuǒ xiàngòng, suí qǐqiúzhě suǒ yuàn jǐyǔ lǐyù, àn zuìxíng qīngzhòng shī yǐ chéngfá, bìng ànshí xǐnglái;
RV-1.6.ja: karera wa sadame ni shitagatte seika ni kumotsu o sasage, motomeru mono o nozomi dōri ni motenashi, tsumi ni ōjite basshi, shikaru beki toki ni mezameta.

RV-1.7.ar: alladhīna jamaʿū l-māla li-yabdhulūh, wa-qallalū l-kalāma ḥirṣan ʿalā ṣ-ṣidq, wa-ṭalabū n-naṣra min ajli l-majd, wa-tazawwajū min ajli dh-dhurriyya;
RV-1.7.zh: tāmen jījù cáifù shì wèile shīshě, guǎyán shì wèile chéngshí, qiúshèng shì wèile róngyù, chéngjiā shì wèile hòusì;
RV-1.7.ja: karera wa hodokosu tame ni tomi o takuwae, shinjitsu no tame ni kotoba sukunaku, meiyo no tame ni shōri o motome, shison no tame ni katei o motta.

RV-1.8.ar: alladhīna taʿallamū fī ṭ-ṭufūla, wa-tamattaʿū bi-maladhdhāti d-dunyā fī sh-shabāb, wa-ʿāshū ʿīshata l-ḥukamāʾi fī sh-shaykhūkha, wa-fāraqū l-jasada fī n-nihāyati bi-l-yūghā.
RV-1.8.zh: tāmen yòunián qínxué, qīngnián xiǎngshòu shìjiān zhī lè, lǎonián guòzhe yǐnshì bān de shēnghuó, zuìzhōng yǐ yújiā shěqì ròushēn.
RV-1.8.ja: karera wa yōnenki ni gakumon o osame, seinenki ni yo no tanoshimi o ajiwai, rōnenki ni wa seija no yō ni kurashi, saigo wa yōga ni yotte shintai o suteta.

RV-1.9.ar: maʿa anna ḥaẓẓī mina l-bayāni qalīl, sa-arwī nasaba āli Rāghū, wa-qad dafaʿatnī ilā hādhihi l-jurʾati faḍāʾiluhum allatī balaghat masāmiʿī.
RV-1.9.zh: wǒ de yáncí zhī cái suīrán qiǎnbó, dàn shòu chuánrù ěr zhōng de tāmen de měidé suǒ jīlì, màomèi de jiǎngshù Luóhù zú de shìxì.
RV-1.9.ja: watashi no kotoba no chikara wa wazuka da ga, mimi ni todoita karera no bitoku ni karitaterare, kono daitansa o motte Ragu-zoku no keifu o katarō.

RV-1.10.ar: inna ṣ-ṣāliḥīna alladhīna yumayyizūna l-ḥaqqa mina l-bāṭili jadīrūna bi-samāʿih; fa-inna naqāʾa dh-dhahab, aw ḥattā shawāʾibah, lā yaẓharu illā fī n-nār.
RV-1.10.zh: néng biànbié shàn'è de xiánzhě zhídé tīngwén cǐ piān; yīnwèi huángjīn de chúnjìng huò qí zázhì, wéiyǒu zài huǒ zhōng fāng néng xiǎnxiàn.
RV-1.10.ja: zen'aku o miwakerareru yoki hitobito koso, kore o kiku ni fusawashii. kin no jundo mo, sono kurozumi mo, hi no naka de koso arawareru no da kara.

VR-1.1.1.ar: saʾala n-nāsiku Fālmīkī Nāradā, al-munqaṭiʿa ilā t-taqashshufi wa-dirāsati l-kutubi l-muqaddasa, afḍala l-ʿārifīna bi-l-kalām, wa-aʿlā l-ḥukamāʾi maqāman:
VR-1.1.1.zh: kǔxíngzhě Yǐdié xiàng Nàluótuó qǐngwèn — Nàluótuó zhuānzhù yú kǔxíng yǔ sòngxí shèngdiǎn, shì shànyú yáncí zhě zhōng de jiǎojiǎozhě, móuní zhōng de zhìzūn:
VR-1.1.1.ja: kugyōsha Vārumīki wa, kugyō to seiten no gakushū ni senshin shi, kotoba ni tsūjita mono no naka de mottomo sugure, seija no naka no daiichininsha de aru Nārada ni tazuneta.

VR-1.1.2.ar: «man fī hādhā l-ʿālami l-yawma fāḍilun wa-shujāʿ, ʿārifun bi-d-dārmā, shākirun li-l-jamīl, ṣādiqu l-qawl, thābitun ʿalā ʿuhūdih?»
VR-1.1.2.zh: 「dāngjīn shì shang, shéi jù měidé ér yòu yǒngwǔ, shéi tōngxiǎo zhèngfǎ, zhī'ēn túbào, yányǔ zhēnshí, shìyuàn jiāndìng?」
VR-1.1.2.ja: 「ima kono yo de, toku ga ari yūmō de, Daruma o shiri, on o wasurezu, kotoba ni itsuwari naku, chikai no katai mono wa dare ka.」

VR-1.1.3.ar: «mani l-mutaḥallī bi-ḥusni s-sīra, wa-mani r-raḥīmu bi-kulli l-kāʾināt, wa-mani l-ʿālim, wa-mani l-qadīr, wa-man huwa waḥdahu bahjatun li-n-nāẓirīn?»
VR-1.1.3.zh: 「shéi pǐnxíng duānzhèng, shéi lìyì yíqiè zhòngshēng, shéi bóxué, shéi yǒu nénglì, shéi yòu shì wéiyī lìng rén jiàn zhī huānxǐ de rén?」
VR-1.1.3.ja: 「hinkō tadashiki mono wa dare ka, subete no ikimono ni megumibukai mono wa dare ka, gakushiki aru mono wa dare ka, yūnō na mono wa dare ka, hitori miru mono o yorokobaseru mono wa dare ka.」

VR-1.1.4.ar: «mani l-māliku li-nafsih, al-ghālibu li-ghaḍabih, al-mushriq, al-khālī mina l-ḥasad? wa-mani lladhī takhshāhu ḥattā l-āliha idhā thāra ghaḍabuhu fī l-maʿraka?»
VR-1.1.4.zh: 「shéi néng zìzhì, shéi zhànshèng le fènnù, guāngcǎi zhàorén ér wú jídù? shéi zài zhànchǎng shang yídàn fānù, lián zhòngshén yě huì wèijù?」
VR-1.1.4.ja: 「mizukara o seishi, ikari ni uchikachi, kagayaki ni michi, netami no nai mono wa dare ka. senjō de sono ikari ga okoreba, kamigami sae osoreru mono wa dare ka.」
